title: Donald Duck no Mahou no Boushi (SNES) - Snow Land
description:
this background and one of the stages of the 4 stages where you can choose is a snow stage and there's not much more than that

- the black area in the background demo photo uses the color palette of the back area so it is possible to use a gradient in this background

- the .palmask is included in the file and is set to black being true to the original background

- unlike the last version that I posted this one uses only one BG slot, the BG2
